comments.text: A third of the country submerges underwater every monsoon season, but instead of surrendering, they build floating gardens and raised homes. With over 700 rivers and the world's largest mangrove forest (Sundarbans) shielding them from cyclones, the resilience and adaptability of the Bangladeshi people is a true human miracle. Do you think you could survive in such a challenging environment? 🌊🌱
